description: What an Immich library holds: assets, storage, people, places, cameras, albums, jobs, backups and integrity checks. Uses immich-exporter with Prometheus or VictoriaMetrics.

links.title: immich-exporter
links.tooltip: Exporter setup, metrics reference and issues

panels.description: Whether the exporter could reach the Immich API on its last poll, and the server version, orange when a newer release is available (needs Immich's version check enabled).

targets.expr: max by (version) (immich_server_info) * on () group_left () (max(immich_server_update_available) or vector(0))

panels.title: Exporter
panels.description: Whether immich-exporter's last poll succeeded (immich_exporter_up).

panels.title: API key
panels.description: Instance-wide, per-user and job metrics need an admin API key; a non-admin key leaves them empty.

panels.title: Last refresh
panels.description: Time since the exporter last refreshed its snapshot. It polls every 2 minutes by default.

panels.title: Disk
panels.description: Used share of the volume that holds the library.

panels.title: Disk full in
panels.description: When the library volume fills up at the past week's growth rate.

panels.title: Queued jobs
panels.description: Jobs waiting or delayed across all Immich queues. Spikes after uploads are normal.

panels.title: Failed jobs
panels.description: Jobs Immich currently holds as failed, across all queues.

panels.title: Assets
panels.description: Photos and videos in the library. The percentage is the change over the selected time range.

panels.title: Photos
panels.description: Image assets.

panels.title: Videos
panels.description: Video assets.

panels.title: Library size
panels.description: Storage used by the library's originals and generated files. Includes external libraries, which Immich leaves out of its own usage stats.

panels.title: People
panels.description: Recognized people, named or not.

panels.title: Albums
panels.description: Albums, shared or private.

panels.title: New assets
panels.description: Net change in photos and videos per interval: uploads and imports minus deletions.

panels.title: Storage by location
panels.description: Bytes used by uploaded photos and videos, and by each external library.

panels.title: Assets by year
panels.description: Assets by the year they were taken (EXIF capture date).

panels.title: Asset states
panels.description: Assets by state. Hidden includes the video half of every live photo; locked counts every user's locked folder. Offline assets are missing on disk and turn red.

panels.title: Star ratings
panels.description: Rated assets by star rating. Unrated assets are left out so the scale stays readable.

panels.title: Organized
panels.description: Share of assets with a location, share of assets in at least one album, and share of recognized people with a name.

panels.title: Library size
panels.description: Storage used by the library over time. Includes external libraries, which Immich leaves out of its own usage stats.

panels.title: Geotagged assets
panels.description: Assets with GPS coordinates.

panels.title: Without location
panels.description: Assets with no GPS coordinates.

panels.title: Countries
panels.description: Distinct countries in reverse-geocoded EXIF.

panels.title: States / provinces
panels.description: Distinct states or provinces.

panels.title: Cities
panels.description: Distinct cities.

panels.title: Map
panels.description: Countries as large bubbles, cities as small dots, both sized and colored by asset count. Each sits at the centroid of its own geotagged assets.

panels.title: Top countries
panels.description: Countries with the most geotagged assets.

panels.title: Top cities
panels.description: Cities with the most geotagged assets.

panels.title: Makes
panels.description: Distinct camera makes in EXIF.

panels.title: Models
panels.description: Distinct camera models in EXIF.

panels.title: Lenses
panels.description: Distinct lenses in EXIF.

panels.title: Top camera models
panels.description: Assets per camera model.

panels.title: Top lenses
panels.description: Assets per lens.

panels.title: Camera makes
panels.description: Assets per camera make.

panels.title: People
panels.description: Recognized people.

panels.title: Named
panels.description: People with a name.

panels.title: Unnamed
panels.description: People still to be named.

panels.title: Hidden
panels.description: People hidden from the people view.

panels.title: With birthday
panels.description: People with a birth date set.

panels.title: Named share
panels.description: Share of recognized people that have a name.

panels.title: Top people
panels.description: People appearing in the most assets. Needs COLLECT_PEOPLE=true.

panels.title: Naming progress
panels.description: Named versus unnamed people over time.

panels.title: Albums
panels.description: All albums.

panels.title: Shared
panels.description: Albums shared with other users.

panels.title: Private
panels.description: Albums not shared with anyone.

panels.title: Empty
panels.description: Albums with no assets.

panels.title: Average size
panels.description: Average assets per album.

panels.title: Largest
panels.description: Assets in the largest album.

panels.title: Top albums
panels.description: Albums with the most assets.

panels.title: Shared links
panels.description: Public share links and their protection. Links that never expire turn orange.

panels.title: Partner sharing
panels.description: Partner libraries shared with you (incoming) and by you (outgoing).

panels.title: Disk usage
panels.description: Used share of the volume that holds the library, and its trend over the selected range.

panels.title: Disk space
panels.description: Used, free and total space on the library volume, and when it fills up at the past week's growth rate.

panels.title: Accounts
panels.description: Users by status and role.

panels.title: Users
panels.description: Assets and storage per user, and how their storage grew over the selected range.

panels.title: Pipeline
panels.description: How an upload moves through Immich's processing queues, in the order Immich runs them. Each box shows the jobs waiting or running in its queue and turns blue while there are any; the link into a queue moves while that queue is running. Uploads counts assets added in the last hour.

panels.title: Backlog over time
panels.description: Jobs queued (waiting or delayed) and running, summed over every queue.

panels.title: Queues
panels.description: Every queue by state, as Immich reports it. Zeros show as a dash; failed jobs turn red.

panels.title: Paused queues
panels.description: Queues an admin has paused. Their jobs wait until the queue is resumed.

panels.title: Server
panels.description: Immich server build and bundled media tooling.

targets.expr: max by (version, build, nodejs, ffmpeg, imagemagick, libvips, exiftool) (immich_server_info)

panels.title: Exporter version
panels.description: immich-exporter build.

panels.title: Refresh duration
panels.description: How long exporter refreshes of the Immich API take: the average and the slowest per interval.

panels.title: Refresh errors
panels.description: Failed exporter refreshes per interval (at least an hour).

panels.title: Integrity checks
panels.description: Files Immich's integrity checks flagged on their latest run: originals missing on disk, files in the library folders Immich doesn't track, and originals whose checksum changed.

panels.title: Database backups
panels.description: Database backups in Immich's backups folder, and the age and size of the newest. Immich writes one every night unless its backup job is disabled; the age turns orange after 26 hours.

panels.title: Collectors
panels.description: Each exporter collector's latest run: whether it got its data, and how long it took. A failing collector usually means the API key lacks that permission or the Immich version lacks the endpoint; the exporter log names which.

panels.title: Features
panels.description: Server features enabled in Immich.

panels.title: Settings
panels.description: Server settings that shape retention and face grouping, maintenance mode, how long the running version has been up, and the age of Immich's last check for new releases (orange after a week, when the update status is withheld as stale).

panels.title: Library extras
panels.description: Remaining library counters.

panels.title: File sizes
panels.description: The API key owner's visible assets (timeline and archive) by the size of their original file (Immich 3.2+).

panels.title: Metadata
panels.description: Share of the API key owner's visible assets whose EXIF names a camera, and share showing at least one recognized person (Immich 3.2+).

title: Immich Library
